ex.en: I attached my signature to the document.
ex.zh: 我在文件上簽了名。

ex.en: The signature had been a forgery.
ex.zh: 那個簽名是偽造的。

ex.en: This letter has no signature.
ex.zh: 這封信沒有署名。

signature.en: your name written by yourself, usually at the end of a document

ex.en: Recent J-POP doesn't really have many signature songs, you know.
ex.zh: 你知道嗎，最近的 J-POP 其實沒有什麼代表性的招牌歌。

ex.en: The chef's signature dish is beef noodle soup.
ex.zh: 主廚的招牌菜是牛肉麵。

signature.en: very typical of a person or group and easily known as theirs

sightsee.zh: 觀光、遊覽（常用 go sightseeing）

ex.en: The sightseeing bus ran through a long tunnel.
ex.zh: 觀光巴士穿過了一條很長的隧道。

ex.en: We went sightseeing in Kyoto last weekend.
ex.zh: 我們上週末去京都觀光。

ex.en: Did you have time to sightsee during your business trip?
ex.zh: 你出差時有空去觀光嗎？

sightsee.en: to visit interesting places as a tourist

ex.en: I like simplifying complex problems.
ex.zh: 我喜歡把複雜的問題簡單化。

ex.en: This is simplified Chinese.
ex.zh: 這是簡體中文。

ex.en: We need to simplify the application process.
ex.zh: 我們需要簡化申請流程。

simplify.en: to make something easier to do or understand

ex.en: Tom sat silently for 30 minutes.
ex.zh: 湯姆靜靜地坐了三十分鐘。

ex.en: She read the letter silently.
ex.zh: 她默默地讀那封信。

ex.en: A red light signifies danger.
ex.zh: 紅燈表示危險。

ex.en: What does this symbol signify?
ex.zh: 這個符號代表什麼意思？

ex.en: The agreement signifies a new stage in our partnership.
ex.zh: 這份協議象徵我們的合作進入新階段。

signify.en: to be a sign of something or to mean it

ex.en: There are many similarities between the two products.
ex.zh: 這兩個產品有很多相似之處。

ex.en: The similarity between the twins is amazing.
ex.zh: 這對雙胞胎相似得驚人。

similarity.en: a way in which two things are alike

ex.en: The movie was released simultaneously in ten countries.
ex.zh: 這部電影在十個國家同步上映。

ex.en: I can't do two things simultaneously.
ex.zh: 我沒辦法同時做兩件事。

ex.en: The pilots trained using a flight simulation.
ex.zh: 飛行員用飛行模擬來受訓。

ex.en: We ran a computer simulation to test the design.
ex.zh: 我們用電腦模擬來測試這個設計。

simulation.en: a copy of a real situation made for training or testing

ex.en: I love the simplicity of this design.
ex.zh: 我很喜歡這個設計的簡潔。

ex.en: For simplicity, we will use round numbers.
ex.zh: 為了簡單起見，我們用整數來算。

simplicity.en: the quality of being easy to understand or plain in style

ex.en: The software can simulate real flight conditions.
ex.zh: 這套軟體可以模擬真實的飛行狀況。

ex.en: We simulated a fire in the office during the drill.
ex.zh: 我們在演習時模擬辦公室發生火災。

simulate.en: to copy a real situation or process, often with a computer

ex.en: She simulated surprise when she opened the gift.
ex.zh: 她打開禮物時假裝很驚訝。

ex.en: He tried to simulate interest, but nobody believed him.
ex.zh: 他試著假裝有興趣，但沒有人相信。

simulate.en: to pretend to have a feeling

ex.en: It has been ten years since I came here.
ex.zh: 我來這裡已經十年了。

ex.en: I have lived here since I was a boy.
ex.zh: 我從小就住在這裡。

ex.en: Life has been so flat since I came here.
ex.zh: 自從來到這裡，生活就一直很平淡。

since.en: used to say the time when something began

ex.en: Mike has been making a model plane since breakfast.
ex.zh: 麥克從吃完早餐就一直在做模型飛機。

ex.en: I've worked here since 2020.
ex.zh: 我從2020年就在這裡工作。

since.en: from a time in the past until now

ex.en: Since it's raining, let's stay inside.
ex.zh: 既然在下雨，我們就待在室內吧。

ex.en: Since you're busy, I'll call later.
ex.zh: 既然你在忙，我晚點再打。

since.en: used to give the reason for something

ex.en: He left in May and hasn't called since.
ex.zh: 他五月離開後就沒再打過電話。

ex.en: We met in 2019 and have been friends ever since.
ex.zh: 我們2019年認識，從那以後一直是朋友。

since.en: from a time in the past until now

ex.en: We cannot see the other side of the moon.
ex.zh: 我們看不到月球的另一面。

ex.en: They live on the other side of the road.
ex.zh: 他們住在馬路對面。

side.en: one of the surfaces or edges of something, not the top or bottom

ex.en: Everything has two sides. Fanatics only see one.
ex.zh: 凡事都有兩面，狂熱者只看到其中一面。

ex.en: Whose side are you on?
ex.zh: 你站在哪一邊？

side.en: one part of a situation, or one person or group in an argument

ex.en: I would like to sit in the non-smoking section.
ex.zh: 我想坐非吸菸區。

ex.en: Betty sat in the chair with her legs crossed.
ex.zh: 貝蒂翹著腿坐在椅子上。

ex.en: There was no choice but to sit and wait.
ex.zh: 只能坐著等。

sit.en: to rest your body on a seat with your upper body upright

ex.en: Please sit down and relax.
ex.zh: 請坐下來放輕鬆。

ex.en: Let's sit down and talk about it.
ex.zh: 我們坐下來好好談談吧。

sit.en: to move your body so that you are on a seat

ex.en: Explain to him the difficult situation you are in.
ex.zh: 跟他說明一下你目前的困境。

ex.en: Please inform me of any changes in the situation.
ex.zh: 情況如有任何變化，請通知我。

ex.en: I'm slow to adapt to new situations.
ex.zh: 我適應新環境的速度很慢。

situation.en: the things that are happening in a particular place or time

ex.en: Our ball went over the fence and landed on the building site.
ex.zh: 我們的球飛過圍籬，掉進了工地。

ex.en: The site of the castle is now a park.
ex.zh: 城堡的舊址現在是一座公園。

ex.en: Safety helmets must be worn on site.
ex.zh: 在工地必須戴安全帽。

site.en: a place where something is, or where building work happens

ex.en: How can I deactivate my account on this site?
ex.zh: 我要怎麼停用我在這個網站的帳號？

ex.en: You can download the form from our site.
ex.zh: 你可以從我們的網站下載表格。

site.en: a place on the internet with pages of information

single.zh: 單一的、一個的（常用於否定加強語氣）

ex.en: I can't find a single flaw in his theory.
ex.zh: 我在他的理論中找不到任何一個缺陷。

ex.en: There isn't a single cloud in the sky.
ex.zh: 天上一片雲也沒有。

ex.en: There was a single potato chip on each plate.
ex.zh: 每個盤子上都有一片洋芋片。

single.en: used to stress that there is not even one

ex.en: Is she married or single?
ex.zh: 她已婚還是單身？

ex.en: He has been single for years.
ex.zh: 他單身好幾年了。

single.en: not married and not in a relationship

ex.en: We have a single for 50 dollars per night.
ex.zh: 我們有一間一晚五十美元的單人房。

ex.en: I'd like to book a single for two nights.
ex.zh: 我想訂一間單人房，住兩晚。

single.en: a hotel room for one person

ex.en: The climate of England is similar to that of Hokkaido.
ex.zh: 英國的氣候和北海道很相似。

ex.en: In that age, men and women wore similar hairstyles.
ex.zh: 那個時代，男女的髮型差不多。

ex.en: The color of gold is very similar to brass.
ex.zh: 金的顏色和黃銅很像。

similar.en: almost the same but not exactly

ex.en: I am simply doing what I am supposed to.
ex.zh: 我只是在做我該做的事。

ex.en: I simply want to know the truth.
ex.zh: 我只是想知道真相。

ex.en: Doing that is simply out of the question.
ex.zh: 做那件事根本不可能。

ex.en: I simply haven't the time to do everything I want to do.
ex.zh: 我就是沒時間做所有想做的事。

ex.en: You simply cannot reason with her, which is quite annoying.
ex.zh: 你根本沒辦法跟她講道理，真的很煩。

simply.en: used to make a statement stronger

ex.en: Please explain it simply.
ex.zh: 請簡單地解釋一下。

ex.en: She lives simply in a small town.
ex.zh: 她在小鎮過著簡樸的生活。

simply.en: in a plain way that is easy to understand

ex.en: The rules must be few and, more importantly, simple.
ex.zh: 規則要少，更重要的是要簡單。

ex.en: Such manuals should be written in simpler language.
ex.zh: 這類說明書應該用更淺顯的語言寫。

ex.en: Although studying Chinese seems difficult, it's simpler than you think.
ex.zh: 雖然中文看起來很難，其實比你想的簡單。

ex.en: She wore a simple black dress.
ex.zh: 她穿著一件樸素的黑色洋裝。

ex.en: The hotel room was simple but clean.
ex.zh: 飯店房間很簡樸但很乾淨。

ex.en: She could sing well when she was a child.
ex.zh: 她小時候唱歌唱得很好。

ex.en: I sometimes hear my father singing in the bathroom.
ex.zh: 我有時會聽到爸爸在浴室裡唱歌。

ex.en: My sister sings songs very well.
ex.zh: 我妹妹唱歌很好聽。

sing.en: to make music with your voice

ex.en: You don't get up as early as your sister.
ex.zh: 你沒有你姊姊那麼早起。

ex.en: How many sisters do you have? How many brothers?
ex.zh: 你有幾個姊妹？幾個兄弟？

ex.en: I don't have a car, but my sister does.
ex.zh: 我沒有車，但我姊姊有。

sister.en: a girl or woman who has the same parents as you

ex.en: There are many sights to see in Kyoto.
ex.zh: 京都有很多值得一看的景點。

ex.en: Visiting all the tourist sights really wore me out.
ex.zh: 參觀所有觀光景點讓我累壞了。

ex.en: We lost sight of the man in the crowd.
ex.zh: 我們在人群中看不到那個男人了。

ex.en: The sight of the money tempted him into stealing.
ex.zh: 他一看到那筆錢，就忍不住想偷。

sight.en: the act of seeing, or the area you can see

ex.en: My grandmother's sight is getting worse.
ex.zh: 我奶奶的視力越來越差。

ex.en: He lost his sight in an accident.
ex.zh: 他在一場意外中失明了。

ex.en: Sales have increased significantly this year.
ex.zh: 今年的銷售額大幅成長。

ex.en: The new system significantly reduces costs.
ex.zh: 新系統大幅降低了成本。

significantly.en: by a large amount that is easy to notice

ex.en: He was absent from school because he was sick.
ex.zh: 他因為生病沒去上學。

ex.en: Within one month of going abroad, he became sick.
ex.zh: 出國不到一個月，他就生病了。

ex.en: There is no point in pretending to be sick.
ex.zh: 裝病是沒用的。

sick.en: not well, with a disease or illness

ex.en: I feel sick after the long bus ride.
ex.zh: 坐了很久的公車，我覺得想吐。

ex.en: The smell made me feel sick.
ex.zh: 那個味道讓我覺得噁心。

sick.en: feeling that you may throw up

sick.zh: be sick of / sick and tired of：厭倦、受夠了

ex.en: I'm sick of eating instant noodles every day.
ex.zh: 我受夠了每天吃泡麵。

ex.en: She's sick and tired of working overtime.
ex.zh: 她已經厭倦了加班。

sick.en: to be very bored or annoyed with something that has gone on too long

ex.en: Tom is on sick leave this week.
ex.zh: 湯姆這週請病假。

ex.en: How many days of sick leave do we get?
ex.zh: 我們有幾天病假？

sick.en: time away from work allowed when you are ill

ex.en: I interpreted her silence as a refusal.
ex.zh: 我把她的沉默解讀為拒絕。

ex.en: Speech is silver, but silence is golden.
ex.zh: 雄辯是銀，沉默是金。

ex.en: There was a long silence after he spoke.
ex.zh: 他說完後，現場沉默了很久。

silence.en: a time when there is no sound or no one speaks

ex.en: The teacher silenced the class with a look.
ex.zh: 老師一個眼神就讓全班安靜下來。

ex.en: Please silence your phones during the meeting.
ex.zh: 開會時請將手機調成靜音。

silence.en: to make a person or thing stop making noise

ex.en: Can you tell silver and tin apart?
ex.zh: 你分得出銀和錫嗎？

ex.en: Speech is silver, but silence is golden.
ex.zh: 雄辯是銀，沉默是金。

silver.en: a shiny gray-white metal used for jewelry and coins

ex.en: She drives a silver car.
ex.zh: 她開一輛銀色的車。

ex.en: He won a silver medal at the Olympics.
ex.zh: 他在奧運拿到一面銀牌。

silver.en: having the color of a shiny gray metal, or made from it

ex.en: She put the dirty dishes in the sink.
ex.zh: 她把髒碗盤放進水槽。

ex.en: The kitchen sink is full of dirty dishes.
ex.zh: 廚房水槽裡堆滿了髒碗盤。

sink.en: a bowl fixed to a wall or counter for washing hands or dishes

ex.en: The sun has just sunk below the horizon.
ex.zh: 太陽剛沉到地平線下。

ex.en: The evening sun is sinking in the west.
ex.zh: 夕陽正在西沉。

ex.en: The boat sank in the storm.
ex.zh: 那艘船在暴風雨中沉沒了。

sink.en: to go down below the surface of water or to a lower place

ex.en: The news took a while to sink in.
ex.zh: 過了好一陣子我才意會過來這個消息。

ex.en: Give the information some time to sink in.
ex.zh: 給點時間消化這些資訊。

sink.en: to be fully understood after some time

ex.en: Sir, you have left your lighter on the table.
ex.zh: 先生，您把打火機忘在桌上了。

ex.en: Sir, you are not allowed to park your car here.
ex.zh: 先生，您不能把車停在這裡。

ex.en: Sir, can we quickly inspect your luggage please?
ex.zh: 先生，我們可以快速檢查一下您的行李嗎？

sir.en: a polite word used to speak to a man

ex.en: He is one of the most famous singers in Japan.
ex.zh: 他是日本最有名的歌手之一。

ex.en: That singer is very popular with young people.
ex.zh: 那位歌手很受年輕人歡迎。

ex.en: Mary discovered that Tom was secretly a talented singer.
ex.zh: 瑪麗發現湯姆其實是一位很有才華的歌手。

singer.en: a person who performs songs with their voice, especially as a job

ex.en: Similarly, sales in Europe also increased.
ex.zh: 同樣地，歐洲的銷售額也增加了。

ex.en: The two products are similarly priced.
ex.zh: 這兩項產品的價格差不多。

ex.en: Children often behave similarly to their parents.
ex.zh: 孩子的行為常常和父母很相似。

ex.en: I don't understand its significance.
ex.zh: 我不明白它的意義。

ex.en: The deal has great significance for our company.
ex.zh: 這筆交易對我們公司意義重大。

ex.en: Few people understood the significance of the discovery.
ex.zh: 很少人明白這項發現的重要性。

significance.en: the importance or meaning of something

ex.en: Not knowing what to say, he remained silent.
ex.zh: 他不知道該說什麼，就保持沉默。

ex.en: Not knowing what to say, I kept silent.
ex.zh: 我不知道該說什麼，所以保持沉默。

ex.en: First of all, power off your cellphones and remain silent.
ex.zh: 首先，請關掉手機並保持安靜。

ex.en: Please put your phone on silent mode.
ex.zh: 請把手機調成靜音模式。

ex.en: I need to ask you a silly question.
ex.zh: 我得問你一個蠢問題。

ex.en: It would be silly to do that again.
ex.zh: 再那樣做就太傻了。

ex.en: Don't be silly. I can't do it.
ex.zh: 別傻了，我辦不到。

silly.en: not sensible and a little foolish

situate.zh: 使位於、坐落於（常用 be situated）

ex.en: The town is situated 1,500 meters above sea level.
ex.zh: 這個小鎮位於海拔 1,500 公尺處。

ex.en: Switzerland is situated between France, Italy, Austria and Germany.
ex.zh: 瑞士位於法國、義大利、奧地利和德國之間。

ex.en: Japan is situated in Asia.
ex.zh: 日本位於亞洲。

situate.en: to put something in a particular place

ex.en: When she heard the news, she sighed disappointedly.
ex.zh: 她聽到這個消息，失望地嘆了口氣。

ex.en: I sighed with relief to hear it.
ex.zh: 我聽到後鬆了一口氣。

sigh.en: to let out a long breath that shows you feel sad, tired or relieved

ex.en: We all breathed a big sigh of relief.
ex.zh: 我們都大大鬆了一口氣。

ex.en: She gave out a sigh of relief.
ex.zh: 她鬆了一口氣。

sigh.en: a long breath out that shows a feeling such as sadness or relief

ex.en: Is it always a sin to tell a lie?
ex.zh: 說謊一定是罪嗎？

ex.en: In many religions, greed is considered a sin.
ex.zh: 在許多宗教中，貪婪被視為一種罪。

sin.en: an action that is against religious or moral rules

ex.en: It's a sin to waste such good food.
ex.zh: 浪費這麼好的食物真是罪過。

ex.en: It would be a sin to stay indoors on such a beautiful day.
ex.zh: 天氣這麼好還待在室內，真是太可惜了。

sin.en: something that is wrong, especially because it is a waste

ex.en: Use a singular verb after 'everyone'.
ex.zh: 「everyone」後面要用單數動詞。

ex.en: The noun is singular, so the verb should be 'is'.
ex.zh: 這個名詞是單數，所以動詞要用「is」。

singular.en: showing only one person or thing in grammar

ex.en: What's the singular of 'mice'?
ex.zh: 「mice」的單數是什麼？

ex.en: The word is used in the singular.
ex.zh: 這個字用單數形。

singular.en: the form of a word that means only one

ex.en: She showed singular courage during the crisis.
ex.zh: 她在危機中展現了非凡的勇氣。

ex.en: Winning the award was a singular achievement.
ex.zh: 得到這個獎是一項卓越的成就。

ex.en: Silica is a key raw material for making glass.
ex.zh: 二氧化矽是製造玻璃的主要原料。

ex.en: The factory imports silica from Australia.
ex.zh: 這家工廠從澳洲進口二氧化矽。

silica.en: a hard natural substance found in sand and used to make glass

ex.en: We hired a sitter so we could go to the company dinner.
ex.zh: 我們請了保母，這樣才能去參加公司聚餐。

ex.en: Our pet sitter feeds the cat while we are traveling.
ex.zh: 我們旅行時，寵物保母會來餵貓。

sitter.en: a person who looks after children or a home while the owners are out

ex.en: We spent the afternoon sightseeing in the old town.
ex.zh: 我們整個下午都在老城區觀光。

ex.en: After the conference, Amy went sightseeing for a day.
ex.zh: 會議結束後，Amy 去觀光了一天。

sightseeing.en: the activity of visiting interesting places as a tourist

ex.en: The sightseeing bus ran through a long tunnel.
ex.zh: 觀光巴士穿過一條長長的隧道。

ex.en: The hotel offers a free sightseeing tour every morning.
ex.zh: 飯店每天早上提供免費的觀光行程。

sightseeing.en: used for or connected with visiting interesting places as a tourist

ex.en: Please accept my sincere apologies.
ex.zh: 請接受我誠摯的歉意。

ex.en: Please accept my sincere congratulations on your success today.
ex.zh: 請接受我對您今天的成功最誠摯的祝賀。

ex.en: They say a true friend is sincere.
ex.zh: 人家說，真正的朋友是真誠的。

sincere.en: honest and really meant, not pretended

ex.en: How many siblings do you have?
ex.zh: 你有多少個兄弟姊妹？

ex.en: "Do you have any siblings?" "No, I'm an only child."
ex.zh: 「你有兄弟姊妹嗎？」「沒有，我是獨生子。」

ex.en: My father has five siblings.
ex.zh: 我父親有五個兄弟姐妹。

ex.en: Do you have any smaller sizes?
ex.zh: 你們有小一點的尺寸嗎？

ex.en: Do you offer coffee pots in different sizes?
ex.zh: 你們有不同尺寸的咖啡壺嗎？

ex.en: What size shoes do you wear?
ex.zh: 你穿幾號的鞋？

size.en: a standard measure for clothes or shoes

ex.en: Your camera is only half the size of mine.
ex.zh: 你的相機只有我的一半大。

ex.en: Asia is roughly four times the size of Europe.
ex.zh: 亞洲大約是歐洲的四倍大。

size.en: how big or small something is

ex.en: The steak comes with two side dishes.
ex.zh: 牛排附兩道配菜。

ex.en: Kimchi is a common side dish in Korea.
ex.zh: 泡菜是韓國常見的配菜。

side dish.en: a small amount of food eaten with the main part of a meal

ex.en: Possible side effects include blurred vision and shortness of breath.
ex.zh: 可能的副作用包括視力模糊和呼吸急促。

ex.en: This medicine has no side effects.
ex.zh: 這藥沒有副作用。

ex.en: This medicine doesn't have any harmful side effects.
ex.zh: 這種藥沒有有害的副作用。

side effect.en: an unwanted effect of a medicine in addition to its main effect

ex.en: The stranger gave him a sinister smile.
ex.zh: 那個陌生人對他露出陰險的笑容。

ex.en: There was something sinister about the empty house.
ex.zh: 那棟空屋有種不祥的氣氛。

ex.en: She is absent because of sickness.
ex.zh: 她因為生病而缺席。

ex.en: Take this pill before the trip to prevent motion sickness.
ex.zh: 出發前吃這顆藥可以預防暈車。

ex.en: Health insurance protects you against the cost of sickness.
ex.zh: 健康保險能保障你生病時的醫療開銷。

sickness.en: the state of being ill, or a feeling that you may throw up

ex.en: I never doubted the sincerity of his apology.
ex.zh: 我從不懷疑他道歉的誠意。

ex.en: She thanked her teachers with great sincerity.
ex.zh: 她真心誠意地感謝她的老師們。

sincerity.en: the quality of being honest and meaning what you say

ex.en: Each signatory received a copy of the agreement.
ex.zh: 每位簽署人都收到一份協議副本。

ex.en: The final signatory approved the contract yesterday.
ex.zh: 最後一位簽署人昨天核准了合約。

signatory.en: a person or country that has signed an agreement

ex.en: I'd like to reserve a single room.
ex.zh: 我想預訂一間單人房。

ex.en: A single room with bath, please.
ex.zh: 我要一間附浴室的單人房。

ex.en: I'd like to reserve a single room on June 3.
ex.zh: 我要預訂一間6月3日的單人房。

single room.en: a hotel room for one person

ex.en: I found a coin on the sidewalk.
ex.zh: 我在人行道上發現了一枚硬幣。

ex.en: Tom is sweeping the sidewalk.
ex.zh: 湯姆正在清掃人行道。

ex.en: I saw Tom pushing a stroller down the sidewalk.
ex.zh: 我看到湯姆推著嬰兒車走在人行道上。

sidewalk.en: a path at the side of a road for people to walk on

ex.en: We sustained significant losses.
ex.zh: 我們遭受了重大損失。

ex.en: Survival analysis showed a significant reduction.
ex.zh: 存活分析顯示有顯著的下降。

significant.en: large enough to be noticed or to have an effect

ex.en: As everyone knows, today is a very significant day for us.
ex.zh: 大家知道，今天對我們來說是一個很有意義的日子。

ex.en: This is a significant moment in our company's history.
ex.zh: 這是我們公司歷史上重要的一刻。

significant.en: important or having a special meaning

ex.en: They made him sign the contract against his will.
ex.zh: 他們逼他簽了合約。

ex.en: I'm not signing anything until I speak with my agent.
ex.zh: 在和我的經紀人談過之前，我什麼都不會簽。

sign.en: to write your name on a document to show you agree

ex.en: All the signs are that she is getting better.
ex.zh: 種種跡象都顯示她正在好轉。

ex.en: His laziness is a bad sign for the future.
ex.zh: 他的懶惰對未來是個壞兆頭。

sign.en: something that shows that something is happening or will happen

ex.en: People were carrying signs saying, "No men in women's bathrooms."
ex.zh: 人們舉著牌子，上面寫著：「男士不得進入女士洗手間。」

ex.en: The sign says "No Parking."
ex.zh: 告示牌寫著「禁止停車」。

sign.en: a board or notice with words or pictures that gives information

ex.en: I won’t forgive you unless you apologise sincerely.
ex.zh: 我不會原諒你，除非你真誠地道歉。

ex.en: I am sincerely sorry.
ex.zh: 我深感抱歉。

sincerely.en: in an honest way that shows real feeling

ex.en: I look forward to hearing from you. Sincerely, Amy Chen
ex.zh: 期待您的回覆。陳艾咪 敬上

ex.en: Most formal letters end with "Sincerely" or "Best regards."
ex.zh: 大多數正式信件會用 Sincerely 或 Best regards 結尾。

sincerely.en: a polite word used before your name at the end of a formal letter

ex.en: My mobile hasn't got a signal.
ex.zh: 我手機沒訊號。

ex.en: What are you saying? I cannot hear, the signal here is too bad.
ex.zh: 你說什麼？我聽不見，這裡訊號太差了。

signal.en: the radio waves that let a phone or television work

ex.en: He gave us the signal to begin.
ex.zh: 他給了我們開始的訊號。

ex.en: Back then, people communicated using smoke signals.
ex.zh: 以前人們用狼煙作為聯絡信號。

signal.en: a movement or sound that tells people to do something

ex.en: An increase in customer complaints could signal a decline in business.
ex.zh: 顧客投訴量增加，可能代表生意正在走下坡。

ex.en: The dark clouds signaled that a storm was coming.
ex.zh: 烏雲預示著暴風雨即將來臨。

signal.en: to show that something is likely to happen

ex.en: The dress is made of pure silk.
ex.zh: 這件洋裝是純絲做的。

ex.en: Silk feels smooth against the skin.
ex.zh: 絲綢貼著皮膚很滑順。

ex.en: She gave me a silk scarf for my birthday.
ex.zh: 她送我一條絲巾當生日禮物。

ex.en: There are six eggs in the box.
ex.zh: 盒子裡有六顆蛋。

ex.en: My train leaves at six in the morning.
ex.zh: 我的火車早上六點開。

ex.en: She started school when she was six.
ex.zh: 她六歲時開始上學。

ex.en: My grandfather is almost sixty years old.
ex.zh: 我爺爺快六十歲了。

ex.en: The bus takes about sixty minutes to reach the airport.
ex.zh: 公車大約要六十分鐘才會到機場。

ex.en: Sixty people came to the small workshop.
ex.zh: 六十個人來參加這場小型工作坊。

ex.en: Simon is a name that appears in the Bible.
ex.zh: 西蒙是出現在聖經裡的名字。

ex.en: Simon waited patiently while the train was delayed.
ex.zh: 火車誤點時，西蒙耐心地等著。

ex.en: You have to be sixteen to apply for this part-time job.
ex.zh: 你必須年滿十六歲才能申請這份兼職工作。

ex.en: The bus ride takes about sixteen minutes.
ex.zh: 搭公車大約要十六分鐘。

ex.en: My office is on the sixth floor.
ex.zh: 我的辦公室在六樓。

ex.en: It was the sixth time she had watched that movie.
ex.zh: 那是她第六次看那部電影。

ex.en: A sixth of the class chose to study French.
ex.zh: 班上有六分之一的人選擇學法文。

ex.en: He ate only a sixth of the pizza.
ex.zh: 他只吃了披薩的六分之一。

ex.en: She sipped her hot tea slowly.
ex.zh: 她慢慢地啜飲熱茶。

ex.en: He sat by the window and sipped coffee.
ex.zh: 他坐在窗邊小口喝著咖啡。

ex.en: Take a sip of the soup to see if it needs salt.
ex.zh: 喝一小口湯看看需不需要加鹽。

ex.en: She took a sip of water before she started her speech.
ex.zh: 她在開始演講前喝了一小口水。

ex.en: Singapore is a small island country in Southeast Asia.
ex.zh: 新加坡是東南亞的一個小島國。

ex.en: Many tourists transfer flights at Singapore on their way to Europe.
ex.zh: 許多旅客前往歐洲途中會在新加坡轉機。

ex.en: My sister's birthday is on the sixteenth of March.
ex.zh: 我姊姊的生日是三月十六日。

ex.en: He finished in sixteenth place in the race.
ex.zh: 他在比賽中得到第十六名。

ex.en: A sixteenth of the cake was left on the plate.
ex.zh: 盤子裡剩下蛋糕的十六分之一。

ex.en: He is sitting on the sofa and watching TV.
ex.zh: 他正坐在沙發上看電視。

ex.en: The cat was sitting by the window all morning.
ex.zh: 那隻貓整個早上都坐在窗邊。

ex.en: The sitting president will give a speech tonight.
ex.zh: 現任總統今晚將發表演說。

ex.en: A sitting judge cannot take part in politics.
ex.zh: 現任法官不能參與政治。

ex.en: The court's morning sitting lasted three hours.
ex.zh: 法院上午的開庭持續了三小時。

ex.en: Dinner is served in two sittings, at six and at eight.
ex.zh: 晚餐分兩輪供應，分別在六點和八點。

ex.en: Let the soup simmer for twenty minutes.
ex.zh: 讓湯用小火慢燉二十分鐘。

ex.en: Simmer the sauce gently until it gets thick.
ex.zh: 用小火輕輕燉煮醬汁直到變濃稠。

ex.en: Anger simmered inside him, but he said nothing.
ex.zh: 怒氣在他心中醞釀，但他一句話也沒說。

ex.en: The conflict between the two groups has been simmering for years.
ex.zh: 兩個團體之間的衝突已經醞釀多年。

ex.en: Everyone needs to simmer down and talk calmly.
ex.zh: 大家都需要冷靜下來，好好談。

ex.en: After a few minutes, he began to simmer down.
ex.zh: 幾分鐘後，他開始平靜下來。

ex.en: The city survived a long siege during the war.
ex.zh: 這座城市在戰爭期間撐過了一場漫長的圍城。

ex.en: The castle was under siege for six months.
ex.zh: 那座城堡被圍困了六個月。

ex.en: The soldiers prepared for a siege by storing food and water.
ex.zh: 士兵們儲存食物與水，為被圍困做準備。

ex.en: The signing of the contract took place on Monday morning.
ex.zh: 合約的簽署在星期一早上進行。

ex.en: Please wait until the signing is finished before you leave.
ex.zh: 請等簽名完成後再離開。

ex.en: The author held a book signing at the shop.
ex.zh: 作者在書店舉辦了簽書會。

ex.en: Her singing made everyone in the room smile.
ex.zh: 她的歌聲讓房間裡每個人都露出了笑容。

ex.en: I take singing lessons every Thursday evening.
ex.zh: 我每週四晚上都去上唱歌課。

ex.en: The children are singing in the garden.
ex.zh: 孩子們正在花園裡唱歌。

ex.en: I heard someone singing in the shower.
ex.zh: 我聽到有人在淋浴間唱歌。

ex.en: The crab walked sideways across the sand.
ex.zh: 螃蟹橫著走過沙地。

ex.en: He turned sideways to fit through the narrow door.
ex.zh: 他側過身子才擠得過那扇窄門。

ex.en: She gave him a sideways glance and smiled.
ex.zh: 她斜眼瞥了他一下，然後笑了。

ex.en: The car made a sideways slide on the icy road.
ex.zh: 那輛車在結冰的路上橫向打滑。

ex.en: We heard a siren and saw an ambulance rush by.
ex.zh: 我們聽到警笛聲，看見一輛救護車飛馳而過。

ex.en: The factory siren sounds at noon every day.
ex.zh: 工廠的警報器每天中午都會響。

ex.en: In the myth, a siren sang to sailors from the rocks.
ex.zh: 在神話裡，海妖在岩石上對水手唱歌。

ex.en: The siren's song led the ships off course.
ex.zh: 海妖的歌聲讓船隻偏離了航道。

ex.en: He teaches guitar as a sideline after work.
ex.zh: 他下班後教吉他當副業。

ex.en: Selling honey is a nice sideline for the farmer.
ex.zh: 賣蜂蜜是農夫不錯的副業。

ex.en: The coach stood on the sideline and watched the game.
ex.zh: 教練站在邊線旁看比賽。

ex.en: The ball rolled over the sideline and out of play.
ex.zh: 球滾過邊線，出界了。

ex.en: A knee injury sidelined the star player for the season.
ex.zh: 膝傷讓這位明星球員整個球季無法上場。

ex.en: An injury sidelined him just before the final match.
ex.zh: 一場傷病讓他在決賽前夕無法上場。

ex.en: We watch our favorite sitcom every Friday night.
ex.zh: 我們每週五晚上都看最愛的情境喜劇。

ex.en: The sitcom is about three friends sharing an apartment.
ex.zh: 這部情境喜劇講的是三個朋友合租公寓的故事。

ex.en: The two explosions were nearly simultaneous.
ex.zh: 兩次爆炸幾乎同時發生。

ex.en: She works as a simultaneous interpreter at international meetings.
ex.zh: 她在國際會議上擔任同步口譯員。

ex.en: We saw the silhouette of a tree against the sunset.
ex.zh: 我們看到夕陽前一棵樹的剪影。

ex.en: Her silhouette appeared behind the curtain.
ex.zh: 她的身影輪廓出現在窗簾後面。

ex.en: The mountains were silhouetted against the evening sky.
ex.zh: 群山在傍晚的天空下映出輪廓。

ex.en: The lamp silhouettes him on the wall.
ex.zh: 燈光把他的剪影投在牆上。

ex.en: Sift the flour before adding it to the mixture.
ex.zh: 把麵粉篩過後再加進混合物裡。

ex.en: She sifted the sand to find small shells.
ex.zh: 她篩著沙子，尋找小貝殼。

ex.en: Investigators sifted through the documents for clues.
ex.zh: 調查人員仔細翻查文件尋找線索。

ex.en: It takes time to sift the useful news from the rumors.
ex.zh: 要從謠言中篩選出有用的消息需要時間。

ex.en: Computer chips are made from silicon.
ex.zh: 電腦晶片是用矽製成的。

ex.en: Silicon is one of the most common elements on Earth.
ex.zh: 矽是地球上最常見的元素之一。

ex.en: They own a sizeable piece of land near the river.
ex.zh: 他們在河邊擁有一大塊土地。

ex.en: She received a sizeable bonus this year.
ex.zh: 她今年拿到一筆可觀的獎金。

ex.en: He left her a sizable amount of money.
ex.zh: 他留給她一筆相當可觀的錢。

ex.en: A sizable crowd gathered outside the stadium.
ex.zh: 一大群人聚集在體育場外。

ex.en: They live in a sizable house near the lake.
ex.zh: 他們住在湖邊一棟相當大的房子裡。

ex.en: There was a rare sighting of a whale near the harbor.
ex.zh: 港口附近有人目擊到罕見的鯨魚。

ex.en: Police asked for any sighting of the missing dog.
ex.zh: 警方呼籲民眾提供走失小狗的任何目擊消息。

ex.en: A cold can cause pain in your sinuses.
ex.zh: 感冒可能讓你的鼻竇疼痛。

ex.en: She uses a salt spray to clear her sinus.
ex.zh: 她用鹽水噴劑清潔鼻竇。

ex.en: You can find the settings menu in the sidebar.
ex.zh: 你可以在側邊欄找到設定選單。

ex.en: The magazine put a short interview in a sidebar next to the article.
ex.zh: 雜誌把一段簡短的訪談放在文章旁的小專欄裡。

ex.en: It is simplistic to blame the crisis on one cause.
ex.zh: 把危機歸咎於單一原因是過度簡化的看法。

ex.en: His simplistic answer ignored many details.
ex.zh: 他過於簡化的回答忽略了許多細節。

ex.en: The company released a simplified version of the form.
ex.zh: 公司發布了這份表格的簡化版。

ex.en: This book uses simplified language for beginners.
ex.zh: 這本書為初學者使用簡化的語言。

sicily.zh: （西西里島，義大利南方的大島）

ex.en: Sicily is the largest island in the Mediterranean Sea.
ex.zh: 西西里是地中海最大的島嶼。

ex.en: Mount Etna is an active volcano in Sicily.
ex.zh: 埃特納火山是西西里的一座活火山。

ex.en: Siberia is a huge region in northern Russia.
ex.zh: 西伯利亞是俄羅斯北部的一大片地區。

ex.en: Winters in Siberia are extremely cold.
ex.zh: 西伯利亞的冬天極為寒冷。

ex.en: Scientists believe a singularity lies at the center of a black hole.
ex.zh: 科學家認為黑洞的中心有一個奇點。

ex.en: The singularity of her voice made the song unforgettable.
ex.zh: 她聲音的獨特讓這首歌令人難忘。

ex.en: Pilots practice emergencies in a simulated environment.
ex.zh: 飛行員在模擬環境中練習應付緊急狀況。

ex.en: The jacket is made of simulated leather.
ex.zh: 這件外套是用人造皮製成的。

ex.en: The priest said that every sinner can ask for forgiveness.
ex.zh: 神父說每個罪人都可以祈求寬恕。

ex.en: Nobody is perfect; we are all sinners in some way.
ex.zh: 沒有人是完美的，我們多少都是罪人。

ex.en: The cat sat on the window sill in the sun.
ex.zh: 貓坐在窗台上曬太陽。

ex.en: She put a pot of herbs on the kitchen sill.
ex.zh: 她在廚房的窗台上放了一盆香草。

ex.en: She signed the contract and handed it back.
ex.zh: 她簽完合約後把它遞了回去。

ex.en: Both countries signed the agreement last year.
ex.zh: 兩國去年簽署了這項協議。

ex.en: I have a signed photo of my favorite player.
ex.zh: 我有一張我最愛球員的親筆簽名照。

ex.en: Please return the signed form by Friday.
ex.zh: 請在週五前交回已簽名的表格。

ex.en: We live in a medium-sized city near the coast.
ex.zh: 我們住在海邊一座中型城市。

ex.en: She carried a pocket-sized notebook everywhere.
ex.zh: 她到哪都帶著口袋大小的筆記本。

ex.en: I had a sinking feeling that I had forgotten something.
ex.zh: 我有種心往下沉的不安感，覺得忘了什麼。

ex.en: They watched the sinking sun turn the sky orange.
ex.zh: 他們看著西沉的太陽把天空染成橘色。

ex.en: The boat is slowly sinking into the water.
ex.zh: 那艘船正慢慢沉入水中。

ex.en: My feet were sinking in the soft sand.
ex.zh: 我的腳陷進鬆軟的沙裡。

ex.en: The cat has soft, silky fur.
ex.zh: 這隻貓的毛又柔軟又滑順。

ex.en: She wore a silky scarf around her neck.
ex.zh: 她脖子上圍著一條絲質般柔滑的圍巾。

ex.en: The test uses situational questions about real workplace problems.
ex.zh: 這項測驗用職場真實問題的情境題。

ex.en: Good leaders show situational awareness during a crisis.
ex.zh: 好的領導者在危機中展現對情勢的敏銳察覺。

ex.en: The lake looked silvery in the moonlight.
ex.zh: 湖面在月光下呈現銀白色。

ex.en: She wore a silvery dress to the party.
ex.zh: 她穿著一件銀色洋裝去參加派對。

ex.en: In the old days, a sixpence could buy a small bag of sweets.
ex.zh: 以前一枚六便士硬幣能買一小袋糖果。

ex.en: He found an old sixpence in his grandfather's desk drawer.
ex.zh: 他在祖父的書桌抽屜裡發現一枚舊的六便士硬幣。

ex.en: The new form is a simplification of the old process.
ex.zh: 新表格是舊流程的簡化版。

ex.en: The teacher's simplification of the topic helped everyone understand.
ex.zh: 老師把主題簡化後，大家都聽懂了。

ex.en: Some people think this is too much simplification of a complex problem.
ex.zh: 有些人認為這把複雜的問題過度簡化了。

ex.en: The phone case is made of soft silicone.
ex.zh: 這個手機殼是用柔軟的矽膠製成的。

ex.en: Bakers use silicone molds for muffins.
ex.zh: 烘焙師用矽膠模具做瑪芬。

simmering.zh: 小火慢燉（simmer 的現在分詞）

ex.en: The soup is simmering gently on the stove.
ex.zh: 湯正在爐子上小火慢燉。

ex.en: She left the sauce simmering while she set the table.
ex.zh: 她讓醬汁繼續慢燉，自己去擺餐桌。

simmering.zh: 一觸即發的；隱隱沸騰的

ex.en: There was a simmering anger between the two brothers.
ex.zh: 兩兄弟之間隱隱藏著怒氣。

ex.en: The simmering tension in the room finally broke.
ex.zh: 房間裡一直悶著的緊張氣氛終於爆發了。

signalling.zh: 發出信號；示意（signal 的現在分詞）

ex.en: The driver was signalling to turn left.
ex.zh: 駕駛正打左轉燈。

ex.en: She was signalling to the waiter for the bill.
ex.zh: 她正向服務生示意要結帳。

ex.en: Pilots practice in a flight simulator before flying real planes.
ex.zh: 飛行員在駕駛真飛機前會先用飛行模擬器練習。

ex.en: The driving simulator lets you practice without risk.
ex.zh: 駕駛模擬器讓你能在沒有風險的情況下練習。

ex.en: The politician sidestepped the question.
ex.zh: 那位政治人物迴避了這個問題。

ex.en: He sidestepped the puddle on the sidewalk.
ex.zh: 他側身跨過人行道上的水坑。

ex.en: The boxer made a quick sidestep to avoid the punch.
ex.zh: 拳擊手迅速側跨一步躲開了那一拳。

ex.en: A small sidestep saved her from the falling box.
ex.zh: 她側身跨出一步，躲過了掉下來的箱子。

ex.en: The freight train waited on a siding for the express to pass.
ex.zh: 貨運列車在側線上等快車通過。

ex.en: An old carriage stood forgotten on the siding.
ex.zh: 一節舊車廂被遺忘在側線上。

ex.en: They replaced the old siding with new vinyl panels.
ex.zh: 他們把舊的外牆板換成新的塑膠板。

ex.en: The siding on the house needs a coat of paint.
ex.zh: 這棟房子的外牆板需要重新上漆。

ex.en: The Sioux nation lived on the Great Plains of North America.
ex.zh: 蘇族人原本居住在北美大平原上。

ex.en: The museum has a display of Sioux art and clothing.
ex.zh: 博物館有一個展示蘇族藝術與服飾的區域。

ex.en: In the story, the villagers think greed is sinful.
ex.zh: 故事裡，村民認為貪婪是有罪的。

ex.en: He felt sinful for eating the whole cake by himself.
ex.zh: 他獨自吃完整個蛋糕，覺得自己罪孽深重。

ex.en: He was a sickly child who often missed school.
ex.zh: 他小時候體弱多病，常常請假不上學。

ex.en: The plant looked sickly after weeks without sunlight.
ex.zh: 那株植物幾週沒曬到太陽，看起來病懨懨的。

ex.en: The town was singularly quiet that morning.
ex.zh: 那天早上小鎮異常安靜。

ex.en: He was singularly unprepared for the question.
ex.zh: 他對這個問題完全沒有準備。

ex.en: We followed the signpost to the village.
ex.zh: 我們跟著路標走向村莊。

ex.en: There was no signpost at the crossroads.
ex.zh: 十字路口沒有路標。

ex.en: The tickets are sold singly or in packs of five.
ex.zh: 票可以單張購買，也可以五張一組購買。

ex.en: Customers were let into the shop singly.
ex.zh: 顧客被一個一個地放進店裡。

sickening.zh: 令人作嘔的；令人厭惡的

ex.en: There was a sickening smell in the room.
ex.zh: 房間裡有一股令人作嘔的味道。

ex.en: The sickening cruelty of the crime shocked everyone.
ex.zh: 這起罪行令人髮指的殘忍震驚了所有人。

ex.en: The siting of the new school caused a long debate in town.
ex.zh: 新學校的選址在鎮上引起了長時間的爭論。

ex.en: Careful siting of wind turbines can reduce noise for nearby homes.
ex.zh: 謹慎選定風力發電機的位置，可以減少對附近住家的噪音。

ex.en: The Siberian winter can be extremely cold and long.
ex.zh: 西伯利亞的冬天可能極其寒冷又漫長。

ex.en: She adopted a fluffy Siberian cat from the shelter.
ex.zh: 她從收容所領養了一隻毛茸茸的西伯利亞貓。

ex.en: Pour the flour through a sieve to remove the lumps.
ex.zh: 把麵粉倒過篩子，濾掉結塊。

ex.en: He used a sieve to separate the stones from the sand.
ex.zh: 他用篩子把石頭從沙子裡篩出來。

ex.en: Sieve the flour twice before adding the eggs.
ex.zh: 加蛋之前先把麵粉篩兩次。

ex.en: She sieved the soup to remove the small seeds.
ex.zh: 她把湯過濾，濾掉小種子。

ex.en: He used a siphon to move water from the tank to a bucket.
ex.zh: 他用虹吸管把水從水槽抽到水桶裡。

ex.en: A garden hose can work as a simple siphon.
ex.zh: 園藝水管可以當成簡單的虹吸管。

siphon.zh: 用虹吸管抽出；抽取（資金等）

ex.en: We siphoned the gas out of the old car into a can.
ex.zh: 我們把舊車裡的汽油用虹吸方式抽到罐子裡。

ex.en: Someone had been siphoning money from the club's account.
ex.zh: 有人一直在從社團帳戶中暗中抽走錢。

ex.en: The farmer cut the tall grass with a sickle.
ex.zh: 農夫用鐮刀割下高高的草。

ex.en: A rusty sickle hung on the wall of the barn.
ex.zh: 一把生鏽的鐮刀掛在穀倉的牆上。

ex.en: The river left a thick layer of silt on the fields after the flood.
ex.zh: 洪水退去後，河流在田地上留下一層厚厚的淤泥。

ex.en: Silt slowly collects at the bottom of the lake.
ex.zh: 淤泥慢慢堆積在湖底。

ex.en: Years of erosion can silt up a harbor.
ex.zh: 多年的侵蝕可能讓港口淤塞。

ex.en: The mud began to silt the canal, so boats could not pass.
ex.zh: 泥沙開始淤塞運河，船隻無法通行。

ex.en: The hero and his funny sidekick saved the town.
ex.zh: 英雄和他搞笑的夥伴拯救了小鎮。

ex.en: She was always the loyal sidekick in our group.
ex.zh: 她在我們這群人裡總是忠心的得力助手。

ex.en: The bacon began to sizzle in the pan.
ex.zh: 培根在鍋裡開始滋滋作響。

ex.en: I could hear the steak sizzle on the grill.
ex.zh: 我聽得到牛排在烤架上滋滋作響。

ex.en: The sizzle of the pan made me hungry.
ex.zh: 鍋子的滋滋聲讓我餓了。

ex.en: We heard a loud sizzle when the water hit the oil.
ex.zh: 水碰到油時，我們聽到一聲很響的嘶嘶聲。

ex.en: She keeps the good plates in the sideboard.
ex.zh: 她把好看的盤子放在餐具櫃裡。

ex.en: Dessert was set out on the sideboard.
ex.zh: 甜點擺在餐具櫃上。

ex.en: She set the table with plates and silverware.
ex.zh: 她在桌上擺好盤子和刀叉餐具。

ex.en: Please put the silverware in the drawer after washing it.
ex.zh: 洗好之後請把餐具放進抽屜。

ex.en: The museum displayed antique silverware from the seventeenth century.
ex.zh: 博物館展出十七世紀的古銀器。

ex.en: Grandma keeps her best silverware for special occasions.
ex.zh: 奶奶把最好的銀器留到特別的場合才用。

ex.en: The farmer stored the corn in a tall silo.
ex.zh: 農夫把玉米存放在高高的筒倉裡。

ex.en: A row of silos stood beside the barn.
ex.zh: 穀倉旁邊立著一排筒倉。

ex.en: She wore a silken scarf around her neck.
ex.zh: 她脖子上圍著一條絲質圍巾。

ex.en: The cat has soft, silken fur.
ex.zh: 這隻貓有柔軟光滑的毛。

ex.en: At the fair, we watched a sideshow with a juggler and a fire eater.
ex.zh: 在市集上，我們看了有雜耍者和吞火表演的小節目。

ex.en: The argument about the logo became a sideshow to the real issue.
ex.zh: 關於標誌的爭論成了真正議題旁的枝節。

ex.en: Sinatra was a famous American singer and actor.
ex.zh: 辛納屈是美國著名的歌手兼演員。

ex.en: My father has an old record of Sinatra songs.
ex.zh: 我爸爸有一張辛納屈歌曲的老唱片。

ex.en: A Sikh man welcomed us to the temple.
ex.zh: 一位錫克教徒歡迎我們來到寺廟。

ex.en: Many Sikh families live in northern India.
ex.zh: 許多錫克教家庭住在印度北部。

sizzling.zh: 發出滋滋聲（sizzle 的現在分詞）

ex.en: The bacon was sizzling in the pan.
ex.zh: 培根在平底鍋裡滋滋作響。

ex.en: We heard the steaks sizzling on the grill.
ex.zh: 我們聽見牛排在烤架上滋滋作響。

ex.en: It was a sizzling summer afternoon.
ex.zh: 那是一個酷熱的夏日午後。

ex.en: We walked across the sizzling sand to reach the water.
ex.zh: 我們走過滾燙的沙子來到水邊。

ex.en: He tried to sidle past the guard without being noticed.
ex.zh: 他想悄悄側身走過警衛，不被發現。

ex.en: The shy boy sidled up to me and asked for help.
ex.zh: 那個害羞的男孩側著身子悄悄靠近我，請我幫忙。

ex.en: The smell of rotten food sickened me.
ex.zh: 腐壞食物的味道讓我噁心。

ex.en: The cruelty in the film sickened the whole audience.
ex.zh: 電影裡的殘忍讓全體觀眾感到厭惡。

ex.en: Many of the workers began to sicken after drinking the dirty water.
ex.zh: 許多工人在喝了髒水之後開始生病。

ex.en: The plants sickened and died during the dry summer.
ex.zh: 那些植物在乾燥的夏天裡枯萎死去。

ex.en: The waiter said, 'Good evening, Signor Rossi.'
ex.zh: 服務生說：「晚安，羅西先生。」

ex.en: In Italy, you might hear a man addressed as signor.
ex.zh: 在義大利，你可能會聽到有人用 signor 稱呼男士。

ex.en: A sighted guide helped the blind man cross the street.
ex.zh: 一位視力正常的嚮導協助盲人過馬路。

ex.en: Both sighted and blind children enjoyed the music class.
ex.zh: 視力正常與失明的孩子都很喜歡音樂課。

ex.en: The sailors sighted land after three days at sea.
ex.zh: 水手們在海上三天後看見了陸地。

ex.en: Hikers sighted a bear near the trail.
ex.zh: 健行者在步道附近發現了一隻熊。

ex.en: We ordered a Sicilian lemon cake for dessert.
ex.zh: 我們點了西西里檸檬蛋糕當點心。

ex.en: The Sicilian coast is famous for its beautiful beaches.
ex.zh: 西西里海岸以美麗的海灘聞名。

ex.en: "As brave as a lion" is a common simile.
ex.zh: 「像獅子一樣勇敢」是常見的明喻。

ex.en: The poem uses a simile to compare the moon to a silver coin.
ex.zh: 這首詩用明喻把月亮比作銀幣。

ex.en: A sinuous river wound through the valley.
ex.zh: 一條蜿蜒的河流穿過山谷。

ex.en: The dancer moved with sinuous grace.
ex.zh: 舞者以柔軟流暢的姿態舞動。

ex.en: The kids burst into laughter at the silliness of the game.
ex.zh: 孩子們被這個遊戲的傻氣逗得哈哈大笑。

ex.en: Enough silliness, let's get back to work.
ex.zh: 別鬧了，我們回去工作吧。
